headline: Japan Weighs Phasing Out Gasoline Subsidies in December
summary: The Japanese government is considering ending its domestic consumer gasoline subsidies in December as it balances budget costs against inflation pressures.
why: Sunsetting retail energy subsidies can lift headline consumer price inflation in Japan, influencing the Bank of Japan's interest rate normalization path.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Ending retail fuel subsidies eases state fiscal burdens while raising household transportation and energy costs.
